what_this_is: Stand-ins drawn from never-host utilities take the real hosts' places, states and first-crossing years; the specification in PREANALYSIS.md is run on each draw, read with the inference procedure named in `procedure`. Only never-host utilities' prices are read, one file per utility, through the access list.

procedure.label: the selected and validated procedure (step E)
procedure.range: 90% CR2 t range with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom (Pustejovsky and Tipton 2018, arXiv v2 Eq. 4, 7, 8, 11)
procedure.early_years_test: approximate Hotelling test on event years -6, -5 and -4 with CR2 (Eq. 10, 12, 13), failing at p below 0.10
procedure.told_from_zero: the 90% CR2 t range lies entirely above zero

standard: docs/DECISIONS.md, D-38, committed before this was run.
not_in_the_simulation: future hosts as a second comparison group
each sub-experiment uses utilities observed in all ten of its years
utilities in Alaska and Hawaii, which have no degree-day series
access_list: The simulation's never-host access list (step E rules section 9, D-95): a unit is listed only if no load-unknown site reaches it (D-96), it passes every never-host restriction (comparison-eligible with no anchoring and in every admissible history; not set aside or on a bounds list; never a former host without an allow row), is not under a price hold, has a per-unit outcome file, and is usable in all ten years of a cohort window or all six years of the long form. Full-window usability is a requirement in addition to the never-host and price-hold restrictions and replaces none of them; the previously authorized availability handling is unchanged. Wording adopted by the owner on 2026-11-18 (Stop 3), after the simulation's results were available.
readings_adopted: The power wording, the treatment of numerical failures in power readings, and the access list's full-window requirement as an addition to the never-host and price-hold restrictions were adopted by the owner on 2026-11-18 (Stop 3), after the simulation's results were available. No additional run was made for them.
gas_share_assumption: After the other controls, differences in outcomes are modeled as linear in the state's 2008 to 2010 gas share, with a slope free to differ by calendar year. A state's generation mix is a proxy for what a utility is exposed to; the adjustment does not establish that it measures any utility's own power supply (D-59 item 7).
ownership_assumption: municipal systems, public power districts and distribution cooperatives with no row in the ownership table are each taken as their own owner, from EIA's ownership class (D-58 rule 2.2)

selected_procedure.how_counted: kept in the denominator; counted as a miss and as a rejection in calibration rates, and as no detection in power rates; nothing dropped or replaced (D-95 section 3 item 7; E4.1)

power.name: smallest increase detected in the correct direction four times in five
power.definition: power at a planted effect is the probability that the 90% range lies entirely above zero under a planted positive effect; the smallest increase is the smallest planted effect on the grid (percent of residential price, interpolated) at which that probability reaches 80%. The 90% range is the two-sided range as constructed; the power figure is not a separate test
power.numerical_failures: a draw with a numerical failure stays in the denominator and counts as no detection for power. This is separate from the calibration readings (the range with nothing planted and the early-years test), where a failure counts as a miss and as a rejection. The failure count is reported, including zero
